project: Mocerto - Mexican Import Transaction Document Taxonomy
description: Comprehensive field taxonomy extracted from 30+ documents of a single import transaction (SES3555). Designed to power an intelligent copilot that assists customs reviewers in auditing customs declarations and supporting documents. Each field includes an English description to help the platform understand the operation and flag potential compliance risks.

terminology.customs_declaration: The official Mexican import/export entry document (Pedimento) filed with SAT/Customs
terminology.post_clearance_review: The audit process (Glosa) where a customs reviewer verifies the declaration against supporting documents
terminology.customs_reviewer: The professional (Glosador Aduanal) who audits declarations for accuracy and compliance
terminology.annex_22: Official instruction manual for completing the customs declaration
terminology.annex_19: Lists 29 data fields whose inaccuracy triggers an infraction under Article 184-III of the Customs Law
terminology.value_declaration: Electronic Value Declaration (COVE) — digital proof of commercial value filed through Mexico's Single Window
terminology.single_window: Mexico's Single Window for Foreign Trade — the electronic platform for filing trade documents (Ventanilla Digital)
terminology.tariff_code: Tariff classification code (HS Code + national extension / Fracción Arancelaria)
terminology.national_identifier: NICO — a 2-digit extension to the tariff code unique to Mexico
terminology.customs_processing_fee: DTA (Derecho de Trámite Aduanero) — fixed fee per declaration
terminology.pre_validation_fee: PRV — fee for the pre-validation service
terminology.general_import_tax: IGI — ad valorem import duty based on tariff classification
terminology.countervailing_duty: CC (Cuota Compensatoria) — anti-dumping or countervailing duty
terminology.INCOTERM: International Commercial Terms — standardized trade terms defining buyer/seller obligations

document_types.description: The official Mexican customs entry document filed with SAT/Customs. Central document of every import operation and the primary target of the post-clearance review. It consolidates data from invoices, transport documents, permits, and value declarations into a single regulated form governed by Annex 22.

sections.description: Top-level identification and classification of the customs declaration, including the unique declaration number, operation type, regime, and aggregate monetary values.

fields.name: Número de Pedimento
fields.description: Unique identifier of the customs declaration. Structure: YY AA PPPP SSSSSSS (year, customs office, broker license, sequential). Links all supporting documents to this operation.

fields.name: Tipo de Operación
fields.description: Classifies the trade flow direction: IMP=Import, EXP=Export, TRA=Transit. Determines applicable rules, taxes, and permits.

fields.name: Clave de Pedimento
fields.description: Two-character code identifying the specific declaration type (e.g., A1=Definitive import, T1=Transit). Defined in Annex 22 Appendix 2. Directly affects applicable taxes and regime rules.

fields.name: Régimen
fields.description: The customs regime under which goods are imported (e.g., IMD=Definitive Import, ITE=Temporary). Determines bonding, re-export obligations, and tax treatment.

fields.name: Destino
fields.description: Numeric code for the goods' intended destination within Mexico. Code 9 = interior of the country. Relevant for border vs. interior clearance rules.

fields.name: Tipo de Cambio
fields.description: Official MXN/USD exchange rate applied on the date of entry, published by Banco de México. Converts all foreign-currency values to pesos for tax calculation.

fields.name: Peso Bruto
fields.description: Total gross weight including packaging in kilograms. Must match the transport documents. Discrepancies may trigger physical inspection.

fields.name: Aduana de Entrada/Salida
fields.description: Three-digit code for the customs office where goods enter or leave Mexico (Annex 22, Appendix 1). Must match the actual port of arrival.

fields.name: Valor en Dólares
fields.description: Aggregate commercial value of the entire shipment in US dollars. Sum of all invoice values converted to USD.

fields.name: Valor en Aduana
fields.description: Legally determined taxable value in pesos. Formula: (Price Paid + Additions − Deductions) × Exchange Rate. This is the tax base for duties and VAT. A critical audit target.

fields.name: Precio Pagado / Valor Comercial
fields.description: The actual transaction price paid or payable. Must match the invoice. Starting point for customs valuation under WTO Method 1 (transaction value).

sections.description: Transport mode codes for entry, arrival, and departure. Must match the bill of lading and physical logistics chain.

fields.name: Transporte de Entrada/Salida
fields.description: Code for border-crossing transport: 1=Maritime, 4=Air, 7=Road (Annex 22, Appendix 3).

fields.name: Transporte de Arribo
fields.description: Transport mode for inland arrival at the customs office.

fields.name: Transporte de Salida
fields.description: Transport mode departing from the customs zone to final destination.

sections.description: Identity and address of the filing party. Must match the Federal Taxpayer Registry and be consistent across all documents.

fields.name: Clave en el RFC
fields.description: Federal Taxpayer ID. 12 characters for companies, 13 for individuals. Must be active and match SAT registry exactly.

fields.name: CURP
fields.description: Unique population registry code. Required only for natural persons, not legal entities.

fields.name: Nombre / Razón Social
fields.description: Full legal name exactly as registered with SAT.

fields.name: Domicilio
fields.description: Full fiscal address including street, number, neighborhood, postal code, city, and state.
fields.example: CIRCUITO OLEODUCTO No.Ext. 202 Col. CIUDAD INDUSTRIAL C.P.37490, LEON, GTO

sections.description: Adjustments to the transaction price to arrive at customs value per WTO Valuation Agreement. Additions increase the taxable base; deductions reduce it. Among the most frequently audited fields.

fields.name: Valor de Seguros
fields.description: Base commercial value to which insurance costs apply. Used in customs value formula.

fields.name: Seguros (Incrementable)
fields.description: Insurance premium added when INCOTERM excludes insurance (FOB, CFR). Zero for CIF since insurance is already in the price.

fields.name: Fletes (Incrementable)
fields.description: International freight charges added when not included in invoice price (e.g., FOB). Must match freight invoice or B/L charges.

fields.name: Embalajes (Incrementable)
fields.description: Special packing costs charged separately from goods price.

fields.name: Otros Incrementables
fields.description: Other additions per Article 65: royalties, license fees, commissions, assists.

fields.name: Transporte Decrementable
fields.description: Deductible inland transport costs within Mexico per Article 66.

fields.name: Seguros Decrementable
fields.description: Deductible domestic-leg insurance costs.

fields.name: Carga Decrementable
fields.description: Deductible loading costs at the Mexican port.

fields.name: Descarga Decrementable
fields.description: Deductible unloading costs at the Mexican port.

fields.name: Otros Decrementables
fields.description: Other deductions per Article 66: installation, assembly, or technical assistance.

sections.description: Administrative and temporal data governing validity, payment, and physical handling.

fields.name: Código de Aceptación
fields.description: Alphanumeric code from customs electronic system confirming the declaration was accepted for processing. Acts as digital receipt.

fields.name: Clave de Sección Aduanera
fields.description: Specific customs sub-office where the declaration is processed.

fields.name: Marcas, Números y Total de Bultos
fields.description: Package identification marks plus total count. Must match B/L and packing list. Discrepancies trigger inspection.

fields.name: Fecha de Entrada
fields.description: Date goods physically entered Mexico. Determines applicable exchange rate, tariff rates, and regulations.

fields.name: Fecha de Pago
fields.description: Date import taxes were paid. Late payment triggers surcharges.

sections.description: Fixed fees applied per declaration regardless of line count.

fields.name: DTA
fields.description: Fixed-amount processing fee. Currently MXN 445 for definitive imports. Rate type 4 = fixed peso amount.

fields.name: PRV
fields.description: Pre-validation service fee. Currently MXN 290. Rate type 2 = fixed amount.

fields.name: IVA sobre PRV
fields.description: VAT on the pre-validation fee. Rate type 1 = percentage. Currently 16%.

sections.description: Summary of all taxes, duties, and fees due. This is what the importer pays. The reviewer must verify each line against line-item calculations.

fields.name: Concepto
fields.description: Identifier for each tax line: DTA, PRV, IVA, CC, IGI/IGE.

fields.name: Forma de Pago
fields.description: Code: 0=Cash/electronic, 6=Prior deposit, 12=Certified check.

fields.name: Importe
fields.description: Calculated amount in pesos for this concept.

fields.name: Total Efectivo
fields.description: Sum of all tax amounts payable in cash/electronic.

fields.name: Total Otros
fields.description: Amounts paid through guarantees, deposits, etc.

fields.name: Total
fields.description: Total due. Must equal sum of all lines and match payment confirmation.

sections.description: Electronic payment details linking the declaration to the bank transaction.

fields.name: Línea de Captura
fields.description: Unique code for bank payment. Links bank transaction to this declaration. Errors mean payment cannot be matched.

fields.name: Institución Bancaria
fields.description: Bank that processed the payment.

fields.name: Importe Pagado
fields.description: Actual bank debit. Must match the grand total.

fields.name: Fecha de Pago Electrónico
fields.description: Bank processing timestamp. Must match the declaration's payment date.

fields.name: Número de Operación Bancaria
fields.description: Bank's internal reference for the payment.

fields.name: Número de Transacción SAT
fields.description: SAT's confirmation number for receipt of payment.

sections.description: Foreign supplier information. Must match invoice and value declaration. Related-party status affects valuation rules.

fields.name: ID Fiscal del Proveedor
fields.description: Foreign supplier's tax ID in their country. Must match invoice and value declaration exactly.

fields.name: Nombre del Proveedor
fields.description: Full legal name. Must be consistent across invoice, B/L, and value declaration.

fields.name: Domicilio del Proveedor
fields.description: Full address including street, city, province, postal code, and country.

fields.name: Vinculación
fields.description: Whether buyer and seller are related (parent-subsidiary, common ownership). If yes, transaction value may be challenged.

sections.description: References to commercial invoices. Each links to an electronic value declaration (COVE). Must be perfectly consistent with physical invoices.

fields.name: Número de Factura
fields.description: Invoice number as issued by the supplier. Must match physical invoice and COVE.

fields.name: Fecha de Factura
fields.description: Date the invoice was issued. Should precede shipment and entry dates.

fields.name: INCOTERM
fields.description: Trade term (CIF, FOB, EXW, etc.) defining which costs are in the price vs. declared separately. Critical for correct customs valuation.

fields.name: Moneda de Factura
fields.description: ISO currency code (USD, EUR, CNY). Determines conversion factor applicability.

fields.name: Valor en Moneda de Factura
fields.description: Total invoice amount in original currency before conversion.

fields.name: Factor de Moneda
fields.description: Rate to convert invoice currency to USD. 1.0 if already in USD.

fields.name: Valor en Dólares (por factura)
fields.description: Invoice value converted to USD. Sum of all should equal header-level total.

fields.name: Acuse de Valor (COVE)
fields.description: COVE number linking this invoice to its electronic filing. Reviewer must verify COVE data matches physical invoice.

sections.description: Detailed transport data from the annex pages identifying vessel, carrier, and B/L numbers.

fields.name: Identificación del Transporte
fields.description: Name of the ocean vessel, aircraft, or vehicle. Must match the B/L.

fields.name: País del Transporte
fields.description: ISO country code of vessel registration (e.g., MHL=Marshall Islands).

fields.name: Número de Guía / Embarque
fields.description: B/L or waybill numbers linking the declaration to transport documents.

fields.name: Tipo de Guía
fields.description: M=Master (carrier-issued), H=House (forwarder-issued). Affects traceability.

fields.name: RFC del Transportista
fields.description: Mexican tax ID of the carrier, if applicable.

fields.name: CURP del Transportista
fields.description: Personal ID of carrier's representative, if applicable.

sections.description: Coded supplementary data attached to the declaration: e-document references, container/seal info, permits, and trade routes. Defined in Annex 22, Appendix 8.

fields.name: Clave de Identificador
fields.description: Two-character code specifying the data type: ED=e-document, CS=Container/Seals, IC=Incoterm, CR=Carrier route, TL=Trade location, PO=Purchase order, EO=Export operation, PM=Permit type, C1=Permit/Standard.

fields.name: Complemento 1
fields.description: Primary value for the identifier (e.g., e-document number for ED, container number for CS).

fields.name: Complemento 2
fields.description: Secondary context value (e.g., container count for CS, supplier name for PO).

fields.name: Complemento 3
fields.description: Tertiary value for identifiers needing three data points.

sections.description: Each line represents a product classified under a specific tariff code. Where detailed duty calculation happens. The reviewer verifies classification, origin, quantities, values, and taxes for each line.

fields.name: Secuencial
fields.description: Sequential line item number, starting at 1.

fields.name: Fracción Arancelaria
fields.description: 8-digit code from Mexico's tariff schedule classifying the product. Determines duty rate, regulations, and restrictions. Incorrect classification is one of the most common and costly audit findings.

fields.name: Subdivisión / NICO
fields.description: 2-digit national extension unique to Mexico providing additional regulatory granularity. Must be declared with the tariff code.

fields.name: Vinculación (partida)
fields.description: Whether buyer and seller are related for this line. Usually mirrors declaration-level indicator.

fields.name: Método de Valoración
fields.description: WTO method: 1=Transaction value (most common), 2-6=Alternative methods. Non-Method-1 requires additional justification.

fields.name: Unidad de Medida Comercial
fields.description: Code for the commercial transaction unit (e.g., 14=metric tons). Annex 22, Appendix 7.

fields.name: Cantidad Comercial
fields.description: Quantity in commercial unit. Must match invoice and packing list.

fields.name: Unidad de Medida Arancelaria
fields.description: Unit prescribed by the tariff schedule for this code. May differ from commercial unit.

fields.name: Cantidad Arancelaria
fields.description: Quantity in tariff unit, used for duty calculation. Conversion errors are a common source of fines.

fields.name: País Vendedor/Comprador
fields.description: ISO 3-letter code of the seller (imports) or buyer (exports). Affects preferential tariff eligibility and countervailing duties.

fields.name: País de Origen/Destino
fields.description: Country where goods were manufactured or substantially transformed. Determines FTA preferences and countervailing duty applicability.

fields.name: Descripción de la Mercancía
fields.description: Free-text description supporting the tariff classification. Must match the invoice.

fields.name: Valor en Aduana (partida)
fields.description: Customs value allocated to this line in pesos. Sum of all lines must equal header-level customs value.

fields.name: Precio Pagado (partida)
fields.description: Portion of total price paid for this line.

fields.name: Precio Unitario
fields.description: Price per tariff unit. Used for valuation cross-checks and reasonableness analysis.

fields.name: Valor Agregado
fields.description: For IMMEX maquiladora companies, the value added in Mexico. Zero for standard imports.

fields.name: Contribución
fields.description: Specific tax: CC=Countervailing duty, IGI/IGE=General import tax, IVA=Value Added Tax.

fields.name: Tasa
fields.description: Applicable rate for this tax on this line (e.g., 7% CC, 16% IVA).

fields.name: Tipo de Tasa
fields.description: How rate is applied: 1=Ad valorem (%), 2=Specific (per unit), 4=Fixed amount.

fields.name: Forma de Pago (partida)
fields.description: Payment method for this specific tax line. Usually 0 (electronic).

fields.name: Importe (partida)
fields.description: Calculated tax in pesos. For ad valorem: Customs Value × Rate.

fields.name: Clave de Permiso/NOM
fields.description: Code for required permit or Mexican Official Standard. C1=Import permit required.

fields.name: Número de Permiso/NOM
fields.description: The actual permit or NOM certificate number. Must be valid, not expired, and match the product. Missing permits are a major fine source.

fields.name: Firma de Descargo
fields.description: Digital signature confirming the permit quantity was debited against this declaration.

fields.name: Valor Comercial en Dólares (partida)
fields.description: Commercial value per line in USD. Sum should match header USD value.

fields.name: Cantidad UMT/C
fields.description: Alternative quantity field for cross-checking.

fields.name: Marca
fields.description: Product brand name. Required for certain categories; used in physical inspections.

fields.name: Modelo
fields.description: Model number. Required when goods must be individually identified.

fields.name: Código de Producto
fields.description: Supplier's product code. Links declaration line to invoice and packing list.

fields.name: Total de Bultos
fields.description: Total package count. Must match B/L and packing list. Discrepancies trigger inspection.

fields.name: Observaciones
fields.description: Free-text notes about the operation. Often references value declaration letters (Carta 3.1.8) or special procedures.

sections.description: Identity and digital signature of the customs broker or agency. The broker is legally co-responsible for accuracy.

fields.name: Nombre del Agente
fields.description: Full name of the licensed broker or agency representative.

fields.name: RFC del Agente/Agencia
fields.description: Tax ID of the broker (individual) or agency (entity). Legally responsible for declarations filed.

fields.name: CURP del Agente
fields.description: Personal ID code of the individual broker.

fields.name: Patente o Autorización
fields.description: 4-digit license issued by SAT. Each patent is unique and non-transferable.

fields.name: Número de Serie del Certificado
fields.description: Serial of the SAT-issued digital certificate used to sign the declaration.

fields.name: Firma Electrónica
fields.description: Base64-encoded digital signature providing legal non-repudiation.

fields.name: Referencia Interna
fields.description: Broker's internal tracking number. Not official but used for cross-referencing.

document_types.description: Transport contract issued by the ocean carrier serving as receipt of goods, evidence of carriage contract, and document of title. Must be digitized as an e-document and its data must match the customs declaration. Variants: original negotiable B/L, non-negotiable copies, and the Delivery Order for cargo release.

fields.name: Número de B/L
fields.description: Unique carrier-assigned ID linking physical cargo to all documents.

fields.name: Número de Reserva
fields.description: Carrier's space reservation reference.

fields.name: Embarcador / Exportador
fields.description: Party delivering goods to carrier. Includes name, address, country. Must be consistent with invoice seller.

fields.name: Consignatario
fields.description: Party to whom goods are consigned (typically the importer).

fields.name: Parte a Notificar
fields.description: Party notified upon arrival, usually importer or broker. Not cargo owner.

fields.name: Pre-transporte
fields.description: Feeder vessel or inland carrier for first leg before main voyage.

fields.name: Lugar de Recepción
fields.description: Where carrier received goods from shipper.

fields.name: Buque
fields.description: Main vessel name. Must match declaration transport identification.

fields.name: Número de Viaje
fields.description: Carrier's voyage identifier for the specific sailing.

fields.name: Bandera
fields.description: Country of vessel registration. Must match declaration.

fields.name: Puerto de Carga
fields.description: Port where goods were loaded.

fields.name: Puerto de Descarga
fields.description: Port where goods are unloaded. Must match declaration customs office.

fields.name: Lugar de Entrega
fields.description: Final delivery point, may differ from discharge port for through-transport.

fields.name: Destino Final
fields.description: Ultimate destination, for reference only.

fields.name: Tipo de Movimiento
fields.description: FCL/FCL=Full Container Load, LCL=Consolidated.

fields.name: Tipo de Servicio
fields.description: CY/CY=Container Yard to Yard, CFS=Freight Station for LCL.

fields.name: Número(s) de Contenedor
fields.description: Unique container IDs (4 letters + 7 digits). Must match declaration. Errors trigger Article 184-III infractions.

fields.name: Número(s) de Sello
fields.description: Security seal numbers. Mismatches suggest tampering and trigger inspection.

fields.name: Marcas y Números
fields.description: Package identification marks. N/M = No Marks.

fields.name: Cantidad de Bultos
fields.description: Total packages, bags, or shipping units.

fields.name: Descripción de la Mercancía
fields.description: General cargo description per shipper. Must be consistent with invoice.

fields.name: Peso Bruto
fields.description: Total gross weight declared by shipper. Must be consistent with declaration and packing list.

fields.name: Volumen
fields.description: Total cargo volume in cubic meters.

fields.name: Flete Pagadero En
fields.description: Payment location: Prepaid (shipper pays at origin) or Collect (consignee pays at destination). Affects whether freight is in invoice price.

fields.name: Contrato de Servicio
fields.description: Carrier's service contract for freight rate verification.

fields.name: Valor Declarado
fields.description: Shipper-declared value for carrier liability purposes.

fields.name: Flete Prepagado
fields.description: Freight paid in advance at origin.

fields.name: Flete por Cobrar
fields.description: Freight to be collected at destination.

fields.name: Fecha de Recepción
fields.description: Date carrier received the goods.

fields.name: Fecha de Embarque
fields.description: Date goods loaded onto vessel. Critical for insurance and L/C compliance.

fields.name: Lugar de Emisión
fields.description: City where B/L was issued.

fields.name: Originales Emitidos
fields.description: Count of negotiable originals issued (typically 3).

fields.name: Tamaño/Tipo de Contenedor
fields.description: Size in feet and type code (20 DC, 40 HR, etc.). Must match declaration.

fields.name: Peso Neto por Contenedor
fields.description: Net cargo weight excluding container tare.

fields.name: Tipo de Tráfico
fields.description: On Delivery Orders: FCL or LCL handling type.

fields.name: Fecha Estimada de Arribo
fields.description: Projected arrival at discharge port.

fields.name: Terminal
fields.description: Specific port terminal for discharge.

fields.name: Acuse Electrónico
fields.description: Mexican maritime customs code confirming B/L data was electronically received.

fields.name: Número Único
fields.description: Mexican customs tracking number for this B/L.

fields.name: Referencia del Agente
fields.description: Customs broker name and license on Delivery Orders.

fields.name: Autorización de Revalidación
fields.description: Carrier's local agent authorization for cargo release.

fields.name: Devolución de Vacío
fields.description: Designated depot for empty container return.

fields.name: Referencias de Exportación
fields.description: Shipper's export documentation references.

fields.name: Número FMC
fields.description: US FMC registration of freight forwarder, if applicable.

document_types.description: Permit-like document from the Ministry of Economy authorizing controlled product imports (primarily steel/metals). Each notice covers a specific tariff code, origin, and quantity. Its key must appear as a C1 identifier on the declaration. Validity dates and quantities must be verified during review.

fields.name: Número de Oficio
fields.description: Ministry's internal reference for the communication assigning the notice.

fields.name: Número de Folio
fields.description: Electronic filing number from the Single Window system.

fields.name: Fecha del Folio
fields.description: Date the application was submitted.

fields.name: Clave de Aviso Automático
fields.description: Unique key declared on the customs declaration as a C1 identifier. If missing or expired, goods cannot clear.

fields.name: Número de Certificado
fields.description: Certificate reference linking to the permit series.

fields.name: RFC del Importador
fields.description: Tax ID of the authorized entity. Notice is non-transferable.

fields.name: Razón Social
fields.description: Full legal name matching the declaration.

fields.name: Domicilio del Importador
fields.description: Registered address of the importer.

fields.name: Clave Válida Desde
fields.description: Start of validity. Declaration entry date must be within the valid period.

fields.name: Clave Válida Hasta
fields.description: Expiration date. After this, the notice cannot be used. Reviewer must verify entry date is before expiration.

fields.name: Fracción Arancelaria
fields.description: Specific tariff code authorized. Must match the declaration line exactly.

fields.name: NICO
fields.description: 2-digit extension matching the declaration.

fields.name: País de Origen
fields.description: Origin country for which the notice is valid. Different origins require separate notices.

fields.name: Cantidad
fields.description: Maximum quantity authorized. Declared quantity must not exceed this.

fields.name: Unidad de Medida
fields.description: Unit for the authorized quantity (e.g., metric tons).

fields.name: Valor en Dólares
fields.description: Value ceiling covered by this notice.

fields.name: Precio Unitario
fields.description: Declared unit price, monitored for potential dumping.

fields.name: Descripción
fields.description: Detailed product description from the application.

fields.name: Perfil
fields.description: Physical shape of the steel product (flat bar, round, angle). Steel-industry-specific.

fields.name: Calidad
fields.description: Metallurgical grade (e.g., SAE 1018). Must match certificate of analysis.

fields.name: Tipo de Acero
fields.description: Classification (unalloyed, stainless, alloy). Affects tariff and countervailing duties.

fields.name: Tipo de Recubrimiento
fields.description: Surface treatment (galvanized, painted, uncoated). Affects tariff classification.

fields.name: Norma
fields.description: Manufacturing standard (ASTM A108, JIS G3302).

fields.name: Aduana de Entrada
fields.description: Authorized customs entry point. Must match declaration.

fields.name: Fecha de Envío
fields.description: Expected or actual shipment date.

fields.name: Representación Federal
fields.description: Regional office that issued the notice.

fields.name: Colada
fields.description: Steel mill's production batch ID for traceability and dumping investigations.

fields.name: Medida
fields.description: Physical dimensions (thickness × width, diameter). Must match certificate of analysis.

fields.name: Longitud
fields.description: Length or range in millimeters.

fields.name: Composición Química
fields.description: Element percentages (C, Mn, Si, S, P, Cr, Ni, Mo, Cu, Sn, V, Al, N, CE). Must match certificate of analysis. Critical for classification verification.

fields.name: Bultos por Línea
fields.description: Package count per dimension/heat combination.

fields.name: Proveedor / Planta
fields.description: Mill or plant identifier for traceability and anti-dumping.

document_types.description: Electronic filing of invoice/value data through Mexico's Single Window. Every declaration must reference at least one. The reviewer must verify consistency between the COVE, physical invoice, and declaration.

fields.name: Número de COVE
fields.description: Unique Single Window identifier referenced on the declaration.

fields.name: Tipo de Operación
fields.description: Import or export.

fields.name: Relación de Facturas
fields.description: Whether this covers one invoice or groups multiple.

fields.name: Número de Factura
fields.description: Must match the physical invoice exactly.

fields.name: Tipo de Figura
fields.description: Who filed: importer, exporter, or broker.

fields.name: Fecha de Expedición
fields.description: Date COVE was created and submitted.

fields.name: Observaciones
fields.description: Often references value declaration letters when supplementation is needed.

fields.name: RFC de Consulta
fields.description: Customs broker authorized to use this COVE.

fields.name: Número de Patente
fields.description: Broker's license number.

fields.name: Subdivisión
fields.description: Whether goods will be split across multiple declarations.

fields.name: Certificado de Origen
fields.description: Whether this COVE also serves as origin certificate for preferential tariff.

fields.name: Exportador Autorizado
fields.description: Exporter's FTA registration enabling origin self-certification.

fields.name: Tipo de ID Proveedor
fields.description: ID type used: TAX_ID, NO_TAX_ID, RFC, CURP.

fields.name: Tax ID del Proveedor
fields.description: Foreign supplier's tax number. Must match invoice and declaration.

fields.name: Nombre del Proveedor
fields.description: Full legal name from invoice.

fields.name: Domicilio del Proveedor
fields.description: Structured address: street, ext/int numbers, postal code, city, state, country.

fields.name: Tipo de ID Destinatario
fields.description: ID type for Mexican consignee (typically RFC).

fields.name: RFC del Destinatario
fields.description: Mexican importer's RFC.

fields.name: Nombre del Destinatario
fields.description: Importer's legal name.

fields.name: Domicilio del Destinatario
fields.description: Structured address of importer.

fields.name: Descripción de Mercancía
fields.description: Generic goods description. Must match invoice and declaration.

fields.name: Unidad de Medida
fields.description: Quantity unit (metric ton, kg, pieces).

fields.name: Cantidad
fields.description: Quantity matching the invoice.

fields.name: Tipo de Moneda
fields.description: Invoice currency.

fields.name: Valor Unitario
fields.description: Price per unit with up to 6 decimal places.

fields.name: Valor Total
fields.description: Total in invoice currency (quantity × unit value).

document_types.description: The 29 data fields from Annex 19 of the General Foreign Trade Rules 2026 whose inaccuracy, falsity, or omission triggers an infraction under Article 184, Section III of the Customs Law. The review copilot must prioritize verifying these fields. Each entry maps to its corresponding field ID in the taxonomy.

critical_fields.name_en: Entry date of goods into Mexico
Country of origin or last destination
